headline: Draft school resource officer agreement and police procedures received; officer data referred for review
summary: The superintendent presented the 2026 mental health and SRO report, which lists $184,228 in costs for three school resource officers. Members asked about the police agreement, and the superintendent will answer their questions in the December report. The committee also approved first readings of three policies, tabled one, and accepted the Lawrence School gifts and grants report.
decisions: Received the 2026 mental, social, emotional health and SRO annual report.
Referred to Leadership, Accountability, and Measurement a review of school incidents, arrests, and student plans.
Received the draft school resource officer agreement and the police department's procedures.
Accepted the Gifts and Grants report for Lawrence School.
Approved Policy DJ, Purchasing, on first reading, as amended.
Denied an amendment to remove "by vote" from Policy DK, Payment Procedures.
Approved Policy DK, Payment Procedures, on first reading, as amended.
Tabled Policy ECAB, access to school buildings and grounds.
Approved Policy JLCDC, self-administration and self-carry of medication, on first reading.
discussion: Mental health staffing and demand: Members asked whether funding covers demand and whether students face waiting time. The superintendent said allocations are based on enrollment, and schools can ask for more positions.

SRO arrests and student plans: Members asked how arrests happen at school and whether arrested students had IEPs or 504 plans. The police lieutenant said arrest is a last resort, and the superintendent said arrest data does not show IEP or 504 status.

Sexual assault reporting language: Members said the agreement's wording differs from state guidance on reporting. The superintendent said the attorney would review it again and the agreement would be updated if needed.

Who signs warrants: Members debated whether one person or the committee should approve payment warrants under Policy DK. An amendment to remove "by vote" failed, and the policy passed with wording that matches the authorized signers policy.
